title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 46
description: Ten questions on Psalms 46: God our refuge and strength, the river that makes the city of God glad, and "Be still, and know that I am God."

questions.text: According to verse 1, God is a very present help in what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:1 says, "God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble."

questions.text: Into where does verse 2 picture the mountains being shaken?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:2 says we won't be afraid, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas.

questions.text: What makes the city of God glad, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:4 says there is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad.

questions.text: When will God help the city, according to verse 5?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:5 says, "God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn."

questions.text: What happened when God lifted his voice?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:6 says, "He lifted his voice and the earth melted."

questions.text: Who is called "our refuge" in verse 7?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:7 says, "Yahweh of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge."

questions.text: In verse 8, people are invited to come and see what Yahweh has made in the earth. What?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:8 says, "Come, see Yahweh's works, what desolations he has made in the earth."

questions.text: According to verse 9, what does God burn in the fire?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:9 says, "He burns the chariots in the fire."

questions.text: Besides breaking the bow, what does God shatter in verse 9?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:9 says, "He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear."

questions.text: What does God say in verse 10?
questions.explanation: Psalms 46:10 says, "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations."

answers.text: "Be still, and know that I am God."
